status: Demonstrated via constructed exercise (not a real occurrence) -- see reason below
reason_no_real_occurrence: resolvePreMergeVerdict's STAGE1_CORRECTION_REQUIRED verdict includes a findings-bearing Stage 1 response at the current head even when merge state is otherwise MERGE_READY. No PR in this repository's current history currently presents that exact findings-driven state in a way this proof unit could replay as a live, bounded example without reopening a completed review cycle, so this scenario remains a constructed replay of the findings-only path.
observation: The shipped resolvePreMergeVerdict function resolves a findings-bearing Stage 1 response to STAGE1_CORRECTION_REQUIRED even when merge state is otherwise MERGE_READY, while keeping the correction transition reference-only (PR/issue refs, no restated finding narrative).
